Nice to Have

We’re scaling our Solution Engineering team and this role takes you global from Day 1\. You’ll work directly with enterprise customers across six continents, helping Fortune 500s, defense innovators, and industrial leaders deploy autonomous drone systems that change how the world operates. If you’re an early\-career engineer who’s built real projects (robots, drones, AI systems) and wants to solve global\-scale problems, this is your runway. This isn’t a support role, it’s a strategic, problem\-solving seat where every decision you make drives technical and business outcomes worldwide.

• Be the global problem solver: Interact directly with customers across the US, Europe, APAC, LATAM, and the Middle East—understand their toughest autonomy challenges and turn them into executable solutions. • Own technical success: Lead onboarding, testing, deployment, and scaling of FlytBase systems—ensuring smooth, high\-impact rollouts for enterprise operations. • Drive customer conversations: You’ll be the technical face of FlytBase—running demos, guiding architecture discussions, and aligning on automation goals with CXOs and field engineers alike. • Go on\-site worldwide: Be hands\-on with live deployments—from configuring drone docks to testing mission automation in complex industrial environments. • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with product and engineering to convert customer feedback into tangible product improvements. • Design scalable workflows: Build automations and drone workflows that deliver measurable ROI for enterprises. • Leverage AI daily: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Rewind, and other AI tools to debug faster, analyze logs, automate responses, and scale your output. • Represent FlytBase globally: Attend trade shows, expos, and customer events to showcase how Physical AI is transforming industries. • Early\-career (1\+ yrs) engineer with a technical background (Electronics, CS, Mechatronics, Robotics, or AI). • You’ve built something real—drones, robots, or AI/IoT systems—during college or internships. • Strong communication skills—you can talk code with engineers and clarity with executives. • Deep curiosity for how AI and autonomy can transform industries. • You take ownership—when something breaks, you fix it; when something’s unclear, you figure it out. Bonus Points • Hands\-on with PX4, ROS, Ardupilot, or DJI SDKs. • Experience using Postman, Python, APIs, or data integrations. • Exposure to AI/ML, computer vision, or autonomous navigation. • Comfortable documenting and explaining complex workflows through guides or videos.
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• Deep curiosity for Physical AI: You have an insatiable appetite to learn about the Physical AI industry, drone autonomy, and emerging use cases. You're genuinely fascinated by how autonomous systems transform industrial operations. • High learning velocity: We know you might not know everything about our industry from day 1, but you have the grit and curiosity to learn fast. You're not just busy—you're effective. • Ownership without oversight: We won't micromanage your customer conversations. We expect you to own technical outcomes and customer satisfaction, not just demo metrics. You plan milestones, stay proactive with customers, and anticipate their needs rather than just reacting to requests. • High trust, high candor: You give customers honest technical advice even when it's not what they want to hear. You surface implementation challenges early because you care about their success. The same applies internally—you maintain high trust and high candor with team members, giving and receiving direct feedback. • Velocity over perfection: You'd rather ship a working proof\-of\-concept this week than a perfect demo next month—customers buy solutions that solve problems today. • Full\-stack execution: When needed, you'll dive into code, build custom integrations, or jump on\-site for critical deployments. • Demo jockeys who celebrate presentation metrics over customer outcomes • "Relationship managers" who avoid getting their hands dirty with technical details • Feature showcasers who demo everything but solve nothing—we need problem solvers, not product tourists • Yes people who agree with every customer request without understanding feasibility, business impact, or the actual problem being solved • Handoff artists who disappear after the sale—we need partners who stay engaged through implementation and beyond • Documentation dodgers who avoid creating clear guides, tutorials, or technical content that scales customer success • Anyone who says "that's not my job" when customers need help • People who confuse being busy with being impactful—we care about customer success, not activity reports • One\-size\-fits\-all consultants who use the same approach for every customer instead of tailoring solutions to specific enterprise environments
### **Why FlytBase?**

We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. ### **Ready to Fly?**


If you've read this far and feel a jolt of excitement—not just interest—then we should talk. P.S. We wrote this JD to filter signals from noise. If it resonated, you're probably who we're looking for. If it felt "too intense" or "too direct"•we just saved both of us time. That's the FlytBase way!

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Shift Lead (Shared Data/ODSP Tenant Migration)
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**The Role:**  

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on‑shift technical delivery for tenant‑to‑tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics‑driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.


**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
* Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
* Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre‑checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
* Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third‑party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
* Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
* Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
* Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign‑off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
* Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long‑running migration jobs across shifts.
* Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
* Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.
  

**Who You Are**

**Must‑Have (or equivalent experience):**  

* Delivered **at least one production tenant‑to‑tenant migration** of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
* Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
* Hands‑on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
* Proven ability to run **migration operations in a factory model** : scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
* Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
* Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.
**Good‑to‑Have:**  

* Experience migrating Teams‑associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
* Familiarity with multi‑geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
* Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS‑102\) or SharePoint specialism, or equivalent experience.
* Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
* Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365\.
**Interpersonal \& Consulting Skills:**  

* Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
* Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
* Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids “late surprises”.
* Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
* Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action‑oriented updates.
* Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.
**Typical Deliverables / KPIs:**  

* Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
* Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re‑run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
* MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
* Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign‑off records.
* SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.
**Shift / Working Pattern Notes:**  

* This role operates within a **three‑shift 24x7 Factory model** . The specific rota will be confirmed, but **shift handovers are mandatory** and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
